rl_job_attempts.name: rl_job_attempts
rl_job_attempts.value: "rl_analysis_jobs"."max_attempts" between 1 and 3 and "rl_analysis_jobs"."attempt_count" between 0 and "rl_analysis_jobs"."max_attempts" and "rl_analysis_jobs"."lease_generation" >= 0

rl_job_lease_state.name: rl_job_lease_state
rl_job_lease_state.value: ("rl_analysis_jobs"."status" = 'running') = ("rl_analysis_jobs"."lease_token" is not null and "rl_analysis_jobs"."lease_expires_at" is not null and "rl_analysis_jobs"."worker_id" is not null)
